sa_feasibility_known_answer.interpretation: Independent Ertl-Schuffenhauer 2009 SA re-computation reproduces PI1M's shipped SA Score column EXACTLY (|delta|<=1e-4, median delta 0.0) for 98.9% of a 20k structural sample -> the feasibility instrument is correct and non-circular (ground truth was not self-produced). The residual 1.1% (219 rows) diverges by 0.001-0.66 SA units, confined to exotic heteroaromatic polymer motifs; this reflects the documented RDKit-version sensitivity of the SAscore fragment-contribution database, NOT a reimplementation error. Coating hardeners use only common fragments (aliphatic/cycloaliphatic/aromatic amine, sulfone, ether, oxirane) that fall in the exactly-reproduced majority.
